description: A directive that adds or removes DOM by stamping an `ng-template`. The `*` prefix is syntactic sugar for `<ng-template>`.
Renders the host when truthy, otherwise the referenced `<ng-template #name>`. Supports `as` to alias the value.
Repeats a template per item with locals `index`, `first`, `last`, `even`, `odd`, `count`.
Function `(index, item) => id` that lets NgFor reuse DOM nodes for items with the same identity.
A grouping element that renders no DOM, used to apply a second structural directive.
Migration that rewrites `*ngIf`, `*ngFor` and `*ngSwitch` into `@if`, `@for` and `@switch`.
